name: Comicpalooza
blurb: Texas' largest pop-culture festival at the George R. Brown Convention Center in Houston: celebrity panels, cosplay, anime, comics and gaming.

editions.evidence: Homepage key-art banner (hero:0, filename 'CP2027-Date-Header...'): 'HOUSTON | MAY 28-30, 2027 GEORGE R. BROWN CONVENTION CENTER'.

notes: The site's only guests page is an archival 'Past Guest Highlights' page (/guests/past-guests/) listing hundreds of guests by year from 2014 through the last completed edition (2026) -- it is not a 2027 lineup, so guests is 'none-yet' for the upcoming May 2027 edition and no names were picked from that archive. Organizer kept as given in the seed (Startling Events, LLC); not independently confirmed on-site within budget (no footer/copyright credit line was found in the rendered homepage text).
